item.text: {"candidates":[{"query_id":"q07","reason":"Aggregate pickups before the left join, retaining duplicate zone matches and unmatched NULL boroughs. Cast the summed counts to BIGINT to preserve COUNT(*)'s DuckDB type.","sql":"SELECT z.Borough AS borough, CAST(SUM(t.trips) AS BIGINT) AS trips FROM (SELECT PULocationID, COUNT(*) AS trips FROM trips GROUP BY PULocationID) t LEFT JOIN zones z ON t.PULocationID = z.LocationID GROUP BY z.Borough"},{"query_id":"q08","reason":"Apply the window directly over grouped daily counts, preserving observed-day frames, NULL and anomalous dates, and AVG's DuckDB result type.","sql":"SELECT CAST(tpep_pickup_datetime AS DATE) AS day, AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(tpep_pickup_datetime AS DATE) ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling FROM trips GROUP BY CAST(tpep_pickup_datetime AS DATE)"}]}
